name: liva-toolbench
description: Livanator9000's marketplace for experimenting with Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: crank
plugins.description: Design-first development pipeline behind one routing front door: brainstorm → spec → plan → execute, taking an idea from sketch to shipped code

plugins.name: crank-lite
plugins.description: Lightweight brainstorming, spec, planning, and execution skills for shaping work before shipping it.

plugins.name: crank-wizard
plugins.description: Generates committed, cross-platform TUI wizards (Go + Bubble Tea) that walk a human through the steps only they can perform — brief up-front grilling, an immutable runtime, macOS and Windows builds verified.

plugins.name: effective-html
plugins.description: User-summoned skill that nudges the coding agent to produce single-file HTML communication artifacts (reviews, reports, explainers, throwaway editors) instead of wall-of-markdown — distilled from anthropics/html-effectiveness.

plugins.name: agent-effort
plugins.description: Shows the effort level each spawned subagent runs at on its Agent row and its completion notice, and lists running background agents with their effort in a band above the prompt, except the agents crank-mods' run band draws

plugins.name: crank-mods
plugins.description: Offers the next crank or crank-lite command a hand-off printed as the prompt's Tab suggestion after /clear or a restart, and draws a band above the prompt for a running crank-execute or lite-execute: a header with the task position, stage, landed count and bound, and a row per crank agent with its role, task, effort, elapsed time and current tool
